title: Stateful association to discovery with safe COTP TPDU-size analogue and GetNameList
purpose: Exercise a deeper parser path by pairing a valid RFC1006/COTP Connection Request that includes the TPDU-size option with a minimal MMS Initiate request and a subsequent confirmed discovery request, while preserving only a safe structural analogue of the issue-589 option path.

messages.label: COTP Connection Request with valid TPDU-size option

expected_behavior: A tolerant MMS/IEC61850 parser should accept the layered framing, parse the valid TPDU-size option without entering the invalid shift path, then recognize an Initiate request followed by a confirmed GetNameList discovery request.
constraints_preserved: For MMS over RFC1006, prefer a TPKT header beginning with version 0x03.
Keep the TPKT total-length field consistent with the complete message.
Diversify association, discovery, read, write and reporting paths.
Use only a safe structural analogue of the issue-589 TPDU-size parameter path and not the historical invalid exponent byte.
issue_safety_notes: This sequence intentionally covers the COTP 0xC0 option path using parameterLen 0x01 and a small valid TPDU-size code 0x0a instead of the documented invalid value 0xa2. It preserves framing structure relevant to parsing coverage but removes the exact undefined-behavior trigger.
